items.title: U.S. Inbound Tourism Drops 14% in April, Erasing Two Months of Gains
items.summary: A travel trade group says it’ll take years before international travel to the U.S. to return to pre-pandemic rates.

items.title: OpenAI Builds AI Deployment Biz Around Team Behind Virgin Atlantic Concierge
items.summary: OpenAI’s new $4 billion deployment company gives travel brands a clearer path to adopting AI at scale — and starts with the team behind Virgin Atlantic’s AI concierge.

items.title: Expedia Promotes B2B Chief to Lead Global Supply as Partner Business Takeover Accelerates
items.summary: In her seven years heading Expedia B2B before becoming CEO in 2024, you can imagine Ariane Gorin feeling that the unit had so much unrealized potential. While Booking Holdings might be the much larger business, Gorin is trying to show that Expedia B2B is the secret sauce.

items.title: The K-Shaped World Cup and the Rising Cost of Live Tourism
items.summary: Live-event organizers have learned high earners will pay almost anything for "the experience." FIFA is the latest to cash in.

items.title: The Most Dangerous Word in Hospitality Right Now Is ‘Resilience’
items.summary: The industry keeps celebrating its ability to bounce back. That may be the problem.

items.title: Where Canadians Are Traveling: U.S. Breaks Losing Streak, Europe and Caribbean Make Big Gains
items.summary: Canadians ticked back across the border in April, but they're still booking almost everywhere but the U.S.

items.title: Indian Hotels Company Takes Hit From Iran War. Domestic Travel Is Making Up for It.
items.summary: IHCL survived the Iran war with its record run intact, but the episode was a sharp reminder that even India's biggest hotel company can't fully insulate itself from a war it has nothing to do with.

items.title: Amadeus Widens Its Travel Tech Domain as Sabre Fight Escalates
items.summary: Amadeus didn’t answer Sabre’s monopoly accusations so much as argue the battlefield has moved on. That may be strategically useful, but it won’t make the questions disappear.
